**question-paper:** `latexmk` exited 0 (`main.pdf` up-to-date; pdflatex not re-run). The last compile in `main.log` has one error: `questions/q5.tex` line 11 — missing `\item` at `\end{center}`.

**marking-scheme:** `latexmk` exited 12; no PDF. Root cause: unclosed `\msstep` in `questions/ms-q8.tex` (runaway argument; triggered at `content.tex` line 26). Follow-on errors: unclosed `\begin{tabular}` at `questions/ms-q8.tex` line 21 reported at `main.tex` line 39, plus emergency stop.

## Compile results

| Directory | `latexmk` exit | PDF |
|-----------|----------------|-----|
| `.../2/question-paper` | **0** (targets up-to-date; pdflatex not run) | `main.pdf` exists |
| `.../2/marking-scheme` | **12** | **Not produced** (fatal error) |

---

### question-paper

No errors from this `latexmk` run (nothing was recompiled). The most recent `main.log` from an earlier pdflatex run has:

| File | Line | Message |
|------|------|---------|
| `questions/q5.tex` | 11 | `LaTeX Error: Something's wrong--perhaps a missing \item.` (at `\end{center}`) |

---

### marking-scheme

| File | Line | Message |
|------|------|---------|
| `questions/ms-q8.tex` | (end of file) | Runaway argument in `\msstep`: `{\text {Since the Cinema is at } +420 \text { m, it is to the east of...` |
| `questions/ms-q8.tex` | (via `\input`) | `! File ended while scanning use of \msstep.` |
| `content.tex` | 26 | `l.26 \input{questions/ms-q8.tex}` (where TeX reports the `\msstep` scan failure) |
| `questions/ms-q8.tex` | 21 | `LaTeX Error: \begin{tabular} on input line 21 ended by \end{document}.` (unclosed `tabular` after the `\msstep` failure) |
| `main.tex` | 39 | Same `\begin{tabular} ... \end{document}` error (again) |
| `main.tex` | 39 | `! You can't use \end in internal vertical mode.` |
| `main.tex` | — | `! Emergency stop.` / `Fatal error occurred, no output PDF file produced!` |

**Likely root cause:** In `questions/ms-q8.tex` around the `\msstep` for part (b)(i), the marks argument `{1A}` is inside the first brace instead of after it — e.g. `\msstep{...\text{...bus stop.}{1A}` should be `\msstep{...\text{...bus stop.}}{1A}`.

Non-fatal warnings (not counted above): `Overfull \hbox` in `questions/ms-q9.tex` (lines 4–8 and 10–13).
